title: General Contact & Inquiries
description: Get in touch with the TwinMOS global customer and corporate communications team.
success_message: Thank you for contacting TwinMOS. Our team will review your message and respond within 24 business hours.
privacy_notice: Your details are processed strictly in accordance with our Global Privacy Policy.

title: Warranty Service & RMA Claim Request
description: Submit a formal Return Merchandise Authorization claim for defective hardware inspection or replacement.
success_message: Your RMA claim has been registered. You will receive an email confirmation with RMA tracking instructions.
privacy_notice: RMA serial validation and service records are stored in compliance with our Global Warranty Policy.

title: B2B & Enterprise Volume Purchasing
description: Request commercial quotation, customized enterprise NAND builds, or volume memory allocation.
success_message: Thank you for your inquiry. A regional TwinMOS account executive will reach out promptly.
privacy_notice: Corporate inquiry records are managed confidentially under corporate commercial terms.

title: Official Distributor Application
description: Apply to become an authorized regional TwinMOS channel distributor and logistics partner.
success_message: Your distributor application has been submitted to the Executive Channel Board for review.
privacy_notice: Distribution partnership vetting is subject to non-disclosure and commercial review.

title: Partner Portal Access Request
description: Register for verified partner access to real-time inventory price lists, marketing collaterals, and firmware assets.
success_message: Your portal access request is pending verification. Check your email for authentication instructions.
privacy_notice: Portal credentials require authentication and periodic password rotation.

title: Press & Media Relations
description: Inquiries from tech journalists, review publications, hardware benchmark outlets, and content creators.
success_message: Thank you for reaching out. The TwinMOS PR team will respond with review samples or press kit assets.
privacy_notice: Editorial communications are handled in compliance with media embargo guidelines.

title: Product Experience & Community Feedback
description: Share your hardware feedback, feature suggestions, or compatibility observations directly with our R&D team.
success_message: Thank you for your valuable feedback! Your insights directly guide future TwinMOS product engineering.
privacy_notice: Community submissions are anonymized and reviewed by engineering teams.
